public_rationale: This combines a qualified report of his own research with an explicitly stated suspicion. Treating it as a 500MW ceiling or a firm finding of deliberate deception would change his commitment. The retrieved public capacity records cannot fairly settle those personal statements.
limitations: This does not establish that Microsoft's disclosure was clear, accurate or deliberately misleading.
It does not establish that Zitron's research was complete or his suspicion well founded.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Based on his research, Zitron cannot work out how Microsoft has brought more than 500MW of capacity online in the last year, and he thinks Microsoft is deliberately obscuring whether that capacity was contracted rather than actively in use.

statement.excerpt: I truly cannot work out how Microsoft has brought on any more than 500MW of capacity in the last year based on my research, and think Microsoft is deliberately obfuscating whether said capacity was contracted rather than actively in-use
statement.document_title: Where Are All The Data Centers?

our_interpretation: The first clause reports an inability to account for capacity from his research. It does not impose a firm 500MW ceiling on Microsoft's actual additions.
The second clause explicitly expresses his suspicion about Microsoft's intent. It does not make an unqualified finding of deliberate deception.
The last year refers approximately to May 12, 2025 through May 12, 2026. This identifies the subject of his research, not a numerical outcome to score.
criteria.support_condition: Independent contemporaneous records could substantiate his reported inability to reconcile the capacity additions and his expressed suspicion. Capacity totals alone cannot establish either personal state.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Independent contemporaneous records could show that he had already reconciled more than 500MW through his research or did not hold the stated suspicion. Evidence of larger actual additions alone would not contradict the qualified wording.
